# [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction\#design-arena-api)  Design Arena API

Design Arena is a crowdsourced benchmarking platform for generative AI. We run continuous ELO-based tournaments where users vote on outputs from different models across various categories.This API gives you direct, real-time access to our leaderboard data.

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction\#the-data)  The Data

We track three distinct arenas:

| Arena | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Models** | Foundation models (LLMs) competing on generation tasks—website, image, video, etc. |
| **Builders** | AI-powered developer tools and IDEs |
| **Agents** | Autonomous agents building complete web applications |

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction\#getting-access)  Getting Access

API access requires an API key. To get one:

1

Apply

Fill out the application at [designarena.ai/developers/apply](https://designarena.ai/developers/apply)

2

Wait for Review

We review applications within 1-2 business days

3

Receive Your Key

Once approved, you’ll receive your API key via email

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction\#license-&-attribution)  License & Attribution

Data from the Design Arena API is free to use for personal and commercial projects.

**Attribution is required.** If you display this data publicly (dashboard, article, application, etc.), you must:

1. Credit **Design Arena** as the source
2. Provide a visible link to [designarena.ai](https://designarena.ai/)

By applying for API access, you agree to these attribution requirements.
